name: core-runtime-messaging-action-error-local
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves deterministic local enum behavior for Messaging.ActionError and makes zero Salesforce parity claim.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingActionErrorLocalTest { @isTest static void rows() { List<Messaging.ActionError> declared = Messaging.ActionError.values(); System.assertEquals(5, declared.size()); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.ACCESS_DENIED, declared[0]); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.ACTION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, declared[1]); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.INTERNAL_ERROR, declared[2]); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_ACTION_PARAMETERS, declared[3]); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_STATE, declared[4]); System.assertEquals(Messaging.ActionError.INVALID_ACTION_PARAMETERS, Messaging.ActionError.valueOf('INVALID_ACTION_PARAMETERS')); System.assert(Messaging.ActionError.ACCESS_DENIED.equals(declared[0])); System.assertNotEquals(null, Messaging.ActionError.ACCESS_DENIED.hashCode()); System.assertEquals(0, Messaging.ActionError.ACCESS_DENIED.ordinal()); } }
